tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on paper or surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta labels on paper or surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers (decorative, not for text).

tokens.name: laterite
tokens.usage: The one brand accent. Primary buttons, links, the S-route in the mark, key numbers. Max one accent element per view.

tokens.name: on-laterite
tokens.usage: Text on a laterite button or block.

tokens.name: backwater
tokens.usage: Secondary colour for domain tags (healthcare, edtech), success states and diagrams.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark bands (footer, CTA band, code blocks) in the light theme. Text on it uses paper.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop (64px on mobile).
